about: Lines of code (js, mjs, ts, css, html, py) per area, with ~3% slack: tools/budgets.mjs. An area over its budget fails lint; raise a budget only with a new reason beside it.

..reason: the toolchain: vite.config.js builds public/ into dist/ (TypeScript and Vite); the test runners (+56): vitest.config.js (Vitest through the Vite config, a process per file, the skip report) and playwright.config.js (the browser checks); the flash check (+3): its settings from the environment in server.ts; models (+2): the server's admins and registry settings, the models smoke spec

fleet-box.reason: composition: check.mjs checks module chains, globals, palettes by name and the library as the studio does

public.reason: the UI on Preact: the header and the boot message are the shell's components (ui/app.tsx), not markup in index.html

public/css.reason: composition (+96): compose.css, the module chain, modulation, the Look panel and automation lanes; models (+21): the idea form's model select and the admins' Models panel

public/js.reason: the toolchain: the sandbox's relay moved out of sandbox.html into js/sandbox-relay.js, so Vite builds it and it can take types; the live preview's flash guard (flash-guard.js: photosensitivity), and small-region flicker warnings in the bake card; home hosting: idea polls back off and pause while hidden; composition: module chains, globals, automation and param bindings in the core (render, globals, stdlib), the chain panel and shelf, the Look panel and automation lanes; phones: an adaptive compute rate and heavy-layer badges. Slimmed (−6 %): small modules merged into their callers, near-duplicate builders unified; the Playa view (+679): Mirage-style renderer and geometry; the rig (+96): rig scenes, tags, attrs and centres in the core; the UI on Preact and signals (−374): views and panels as TSX components and the state as signals, so the code that built nodes once and then kept them in sync by hand (keyed rows, per-row update functions, signatures) is gone; TypeScript throughout: the UI takes its shapes from shared/ (types.ts, −74, is gone) and the viewer, sandbox, runtime and frames modules are typed; blur and soften (+240): the rig's neighbour graph and the native blur (core/spatial.ts), chains run in stages round spatial modules (compositing and DMX moved to core/output.ts), choice params, soft() and band(), and the layer's Soften row; the flash check (+230): core/flash.ts counts flashes where they happen, for the bake check and the preview's guard alike, extent() in the stdlib, and in the UI each person's choice to dim and a curator's approval with a reason; models (+93): the admins' Models page, the idea form's model select, ideas followed by long polls

public/patterns.reason: the starter shelf (+241): clouds, five warps and six filters; the effect library (+689): 27 more sources (xLights favourites and Folly ones), two warps and four filters; blur and soft edges (+25): the native blur filter, and a softness param on bars, single strand, marquee, curtain and strobe

render-box.reason: composition: the library (use) and the look's globals reach the bake

shared.reason: the shapes the server and the browser share, as zod schemas: the look and its 400s, a generator's look cleaned leniently and its JSON Schema, the API's bodies, the rig and the library index; TypeScript throughout (−9): helpers reused across look.ts and generated.ts, the core's typed constants without casts, answer-only shapes (User, Idea) as types, with Bake and Analysis added for the UI; the flash check (+10): its settings for /api/me and a curator's reason to approve flashing frames; models (+87): the model registry's schema (models.ts), the idea's model and timing, the admin role

src.reason: the toolchain: Vite's build replaced assets.js (hashed URLs, the import map, one theme stylesheet); home hosting: JSON compression, frame encoding in a low-priority thread and a lane shared with bakes, the frames disk cap, the content-hash bake cache and re-bakes, the opt-in Fleet foundry; composition: globals, palettes, automation, module chains and param bindings in look-rules.js, generated chains in validate.js, and the prompt. Slimmed: http, bundle, frames-jobs, frames-disk, look-globals and validate-chain merged into their callers; the server on Fastify and zod (−700): its router, body parsing, cookies, limits and static handler are Fastify's plugins', its validators the shared schemas; models (+576): the model registry (a file admins edit, checked and read again when it changes, what each transport needs to run), the codex transport (codex.ts, and proc.ts: one CLI call from an argument list, its whole tree killed), a lane per transport and timing in the queue, the prompt built once, the models API and long polls for ideas

test.reason: the test runners: Vitest and Playwright Test, with a reporter listing each skip and why, the smoke check (sign-up to bake at a laptop's and a phone's size), and perf and the Mirage match as specs; the toolchain: build.test.js and core-script.test.js hold the Vite build (no inline script, hashed names, a self-contained sandbox whose Worker renders, the gzipped budgets) and the boxes' core taken from source, TypeScript too; flash guard and large/small flicker policy tests, held to src/frames.js on the real LED map; home hosting (+690): hashed assets and the CSP, transfer against a model of a browser cache, frames priority, cap and cache, the foundry, backups; composition (+450): chains, globals and automation (compose), the render box against the core (compose-bake), the API and generators (looks-compose), the starter shelf; the effect library (+184): every source under two palettes and three energies, seek-safe, in long chains, and a 10 s flash bake of each (library, library-flash); the rig (+238): rig.test.js runs the core on the Folly and a fictional mini rig (axes, attrs, tags, GRB, 300-channel universes), rig-folly.test.js holds saved looks to their frozen bytes, and every library module renders on the mini rig; the server on Fastify and zod (+70): schemas.test.ts (the shared schemas' edge cases and the structured-output schema), auth.test.ts (scrypt's cost and re-hashing, the trusted proxy); the UI on Preact (+190): ui-logic.test.ts holds routing, the modulate dialog's bindings, the timeline on the Studio's state and the sandbox status; blur and soften (+290): spatial.test.js (the neighbour graph, gaussian weights along the wire and in space, normalisation at a selection's edge, the staged chain exact against one pass, soft and band, choice params, the cost beside the demo look), a blurred bake in the render box and in the Fleet box's check, the soften schema; the flash check (+170): a wave a second passes and strobes block, on bakes and in the guard alike, the limits from the environment, the curator's reason, and the shockwave bursting from the rose's centre; models (+583): the registry (models.test.js), the codex transport on a stand-in CLI (kills, caps, arguments, environment), routing, lanes and the cached prompt through the queue, the models API and long polls

tools.reason: the toolchain: vite-sandbox.js builds the sandbox page, dev.mjs runs the dev server; home hosting (+235): tools/backup.ts, and tools/frames-bench.ts for the brotli quality trade-off; composition: build_palettes.py (+71); the rig (+227): build_rig.py and rig_render.py replace build_cathedral.py, adding fixtures, tags, attrs, the render hints and the scaffold Mirage draws; sacn-play reads the rig's output; vite-compress.js (+34): the build's .br and .gz copies, which @fastify/static serves
